# TRAE K2

BLE HID remote firmware for the FoloToy TRAE AI Passport (ESP32-C3 contest badge).

Start: AGENTS.md
Human from-zero: docs/from-zero.md
Decisions: CONTEXT.md
Do not erase NVS after pairing. Do not add GATT. Do not change the HID report map.
Flash: python scripts/flash.py
Backup first: python scripts/backup_factory.py
Bluetooth name: TRAE K2
Gears: Shandian (Right Ctrl / Enter), PPT (PageUp / PageDown). Short OK cycles. Long OK is menu.
